data.content: # Canes Sign Nikishin To One-Year Contract. Defenseman led NHL rookie blueliners in plus/minus in 2025-26. -** Eric Tulsky, General Manager of the National Hockey League’s Carolina Hurricanes, today announced that the team has signed defenseman **Alexander Nikishin** to a one-year contract. * The 25-year-old was named to the NHL’s All-Rookie Team in 2025-26, after ranking second among NHL rookie defensemen in goals (11) and points (33) and tied for second in assists (22). * Led rookie NHL defensemen and ranked second among all rookie skaters in plus/minus (+18) during the 2025-26 season. * Appeared in 17 playoff games for the Hurricanes in 2026, earning one assist and helping Carolina capture the Stanley Cup. ### Projected Lineup: October 24 at St. Louis. ### Preview: October 24 at St. Louis. ### Projected Lineup: October 22 at Edmonton. ### Projected Lineup: October 18 at Calgary. ### Preview: October 18 at Calgary.
